description: List the trading strategies taught on the indicator pages (RSI, MACD, moving averages, Bollinger Bands...) with their tested result against the rest of the market, after costs. Filter by indicator name, direction or verdict, for example: which indicator strategies beat the market on crypto daily bars. Without market and timeframe, each strategy gives its headline row.

direction.description: bullish: buy signals, bearish: sell signals, neutral: signals without direction (measured on the range of the next moves).

limit.description: Maximum number of strategies returned. Default: 50.

market.description: Market. all pools the markets that have this timeframe. Default: the headline row of each strategy.

query.description: Words of the indicator or strategy name, e.g. "rsi", "golden cross", "bollinger".

sort.description: vs_market (best first, the default), signals (most signals first) or name.

timeframe.description: Bar timeframe. Default: the headline row of each strategy, or 1d when a market is given.

name: search_indicators
title: Search indicator strategies
